local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local elapsed=0;local period=0;local ready=false;local clear=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died at animated Hall door')
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;period=period+dt;if elapsed<2 or period<.2 then return end;period=0
 local from=self.position+util.vector3(0,0,66)
 local ray=nearby.castRay(from,from+util.vector3(400,0,0),{{collisionType=nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.World+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.Door+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.HeightMap}})
 local blocked=ray.hit and ray.hitObject and ray.hitObject.id=='0x1093ee0'
 print('RendingOpen ray blocked='..tostring(blocked)..' object='..tostring(ray.hitObject)..' pos='..tostring(ray.hitPos))
 if not ready then
  assert(blocked,'Initial facing ray does not identify the original closed door093ee0')
  ready=true;print('RendingOpen ready')
 elseif not blocked and elapsed>3 and not clear then clear=true;print('RendingOpen passage clear') end
end}}}}
